      "interaction": "Document or facility discrepancy can lead to detention, and detention can place the person by birth sex.",
      "status": "documented"

    "federal_state_facilities": {
      "exposure": "Facility bans in about 10 state/provinces cover all government buildings, and about 9 more cover schools and some government buildings. Six extend to some private settings.       "protection": "About 29 state/provinces, 4 units and the capital district have no mapped ban. The map notes other sex-defining rules may still apply.",

      "status": "documented"

      "exposure": "State minors' care ban (puberty blockers and hormones) with no phase-out. National subpoenas for under-19 hospital records. Proposed rules would bar public reimbursement for under-18 care. Federal corrections policy denies or alters hormone care.",
      "protection": "Care ban stayed in force on appeal. Some federal actions are enjoined. Adult care access is not shown to be restricted for visitors.",
      "interaction": "A minor's care can be denied in the state, and records can be pulled by federal inquiry. This exposes the accompanying guardian.",
      "status": "documented"
    },
    "threat_framing_law_enforcement": {
      "exposure": "Federal orders direct law enforcement to investigate schools and prosecute teachers who facilitate social transition.       "interaction": "Threat framing reaches visitors through advocacy contact and through police and immigration discretion, and it can raise the chance of outing.",
      "status": "documented"
    },
    "minors_guardians": {
      "exposure": "Travelling minors face the school bathroom restriction in the state and the care ban. Guardians face records subpoenas and threats of prosecution against facilitators. Teachers who use preferred names face criminal exposure.",

      "status": "documented"
    },

      "exposure": "Not documented for trans-specific violence rates. The state hate-crime statute omits gender identity. Bias crimes against trans people fall outside the state enhancement.",

      "status": "not_documented"

      "exposure": "Enforcement of school bathroom rules and the exact status of the 2023 care ban after September 2023 are not documented. No source records exclusionary incidents or enforcement counts.",
      "protection": "Courts have enjoined several federal orders. Marriage recognition and national employment protection operate. Remedies are slow and contested.",

    }

  "synthesis": "The documented exposures are universal at entry (sex-marker refusal and fraud-based exclusion), at public facilities across about 20 state/provinces, and in custody, where abuse and birth-sex placement are recorded.
